## Code

### P2 "03-03_menger_sdf" (Compute Shader) · Compute

description: Menger sponge as a density volume. Recursive Escher-like geometry.; categories: 3D-GENERATOR, FRACTAL; inputs: iters:long=4, zoom:float=1.2; resources: volume:image

```glsl
void main()
{
    ivec3 pos = ivec3(gl_GlobalInvocationID.xyz);
    ivec3 size = imageSize(volume);
    if(any(greaterThanEqual(pos, size))) return;
    vec3 p  = (vec3(pos) + 0.5) / vec3(size);   // [0,1]^3
    vec3 pc = p * 2.0 - 1.0;                     // [-1,1]^3

    vec3 q = pc * zoom;
    float d = max(max(abs(q.x), abs(q.y)), abs(q.z)) - 1.0;
    float s = 1.0;
    int It = int(iters);
    for(int i=0; i<It; i++){
        vec3 a = mod(q*s, 2.0) - 1.0;
        s *= 3.0;
        vec3 r = abs(1.0 - 3.0*abs(a));
        float da = max(r.x, r.y);
        float db = max(r.y, r.z);
        float dc = max(r.z, r.x);
        float c = (min(da, min(db, dc)) - 1.0) / s;
        d = max(d, c);
    }
    float v = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.03, d);
    imageStore(volume, pos, vec4(vec3(v), 1.0));

}
```

### P3 "18-06_orbit_raymarch" (ISF Shader) · Fragment

description: Free-camera emission-absorption raymarch of a 3D volume inside a unit cube (front-to-back compositing, Beer-Lambert opacity per step), with ray-start jitter to hide step banding, tint, an ambient colour added to every sample in proportion to its opacity, brightness and gamma. The output is premultiplied (colour already weighted by the accumulated opacity) and transparent outside the volume, so it…; categories: 3D-VIEWER; inputs: volume:image, yaw:float=0.6, pitch:float=0.3, zoom:float=2.5, steps:long=128, density:float=3, brightness:float=1, gamma:float=1, tint:color=[1,1,1,1], jitter:float=1, densityFrom:long=0, threshold:float=0, spin:float=0, ambient:color=[0.08,0.1,0.15,1]

```glsl
// Ray-box intersection against unit cube centered at origin
vec2 rayBox(vec3 ro, vec3 rd){
    vec3 inv = 1.0 / rd;
    vec3 t1 = (-vec3(0.5) - ro) * inv;
    vec3 t2 = ( vec3(0.5) - ro) * inv;
    vec3 tn = min(t1, t2);
    vec3 tf = max(t1, t2);
    return vec2(max(max(tn.x, tn.y), tn.z), min(min(tf.x, tf.y), tf.z));
}

// Cheap hash-based dither for ray-offset noise (kills stepping banding)
float hash12(vec2 p){
    vec3 p3 = fract(vec3(p.xyx) * 0.1031);
    p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 33.33);
    return fract((p3.x + p3.y) * p3.z);
}
```
